name: The Budding Field
developmental_beat: Limb buds: the body grows parts with a direction and a purpose.
plan_refs: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §8 (new parts affect combat, traversal or interaction)

obstacles.role: first platform across a floor gap
vertical wall requiring grip or a jump route

upgrade.name: Limbs — run, jump and a directional strike
upgrade.softlock_fallback: Swim, crawl, grip and the spike burst remain available; no boss requires the strike.
upgrade.fallback_until_implemented: Use swim and spike burst until run, jump and the strike are built.
upgrade.note: One new offensive part, not a branch choice; earlier body parts are retained.

boss.name: The Gnawer
boss.loop: Burrows toward the player, surfaces to bite, then exposes its soft underside.
boss.weak_window: 1.3 s while the underside is exposed after a bite.
boss.softlock_fallback: The armoured front is optional to break: the existing spike burst reaches the exposed underside too.
boss.fallback_until_implemented: Use the Rot Bloom weak-window loop with a bur approaching animation.
boss.solution: Strike the underside with the new part, or spend burst energy for the same damage.

future_resource.name: protein
future_resource.note: Tissue flavour only; the single nutrition meter is unchanged.

narrative.beat: The body stops being formless: it gains a front, a back and a direction.
